content.text:
A fast arena boss fighter for the Playdate! (Now also on PC).

Code, art, animations and music, made from scratch, all human-made, no AI.
Made with lots of love in Lua, with the Playdate SDK.

items: *1-bit aesthetic* (of course). The whole fight lives in black and white.
*Entirely human-made, no AI.* Code, art, and animations by Nitram, with the help of fakku-oli97 (some artworks) and Msoundworks / Teja (music).
*Playdate SDK* for the Playdate ports. *LOVE-2D* for the PC port.

Kazoku was sent for review to the Playdate Store, although it was not accepted (and I am still waiting for a valid reason tbh, shame on you, Playdate guys. Not cool, dude).

However, instead of crying in a corner, I decided to bring it to you all *FOR FREE* instead. Get your copy on itch.io!
*[ carcamusa-labs.itch.io/kazoku ]*

Standard, Unhinged and PC versions available!
